summary: Phase 2 Supabase auth client-side testing: 27/28 checks passed. Protected route guard works for all 5 protected paths (/home, /profile, /bookmarks, /analytics, /settings all redirect to /login when logged out). Login validations (empty, non-email), register validations (empty name, bad email, password mismatch, short password), navigation (Login<->Register<->Forgot), Forgot Password sent-state, and Reset Password rendering all pass. No red-screen crashes; Supabase client initializes correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple non-blocking deprecation warnings in web preview: 'shadow* style props deprecated — use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated — use style.pointerEvents', 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported'. These originate from third-party libs (react-native-web/vector-icons/toasts) and are not auth-related. No action required for Phase 2.

critical_code_review_comments: login.tsx line 64: label is 'মোবাইল / ইমেইল' but current code only accepts email (correct per Phase-2 spec); label may confuse users — consider renaming to 'ইমেইল' in a later iteration.
reset-password.tsx uses `new URL(url)` which can throw on certain deep-link schemes; wrapped in try/catch — acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 auth client-side (guard + form validations + nav) verified. Note: Supabase email confirmation is ON so end-to-end signup→login→home cannot be tested without a confirmed user. The one 'FAIL' in automation (register-rank-modal visibility) is a false negative — the modal's inner content renders (10 Bengali rank options were enumerable and selectable); the testID wrapper is just not detected by is_visible due to portal/overlay positioning. Rank selection works.
